description: React component for handling file uploads in Mattermost, including drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, and plugin integrations.

classes.name: FileUpload
classes.description: React component class for managing file uploads, including drag-and-drop, clipboard pasting, and plugin support.

methods.name: getDragEventDefinition
methods.description: Determines the container and overlay selectors based on post type and editing state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Registers drag events and adds event listeners for paste and keydown.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Re-registers drag events if editing state changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners and unbinds drag events.

methods.name: fileUploadSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful file upload responses, invoking callback and updating requests state.

methods.name: fileUploadFail
methods.description: Handles failed file uploads, invoking error callback.

methods.name: checkPluginHooksAndUploadFiles
methods.description: Runs plugin hooks before uploading files, handles errors.

methods.name: uploadFiles
methods.description: Uploads a list of files, manages errors for size and empty files.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event, triggers upload.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped via drag-and-drop, initiates upload.

methods.name: registerDragEvents
methods.description: Registers drag-and-drop event handlers for the container.

methods.name: containsEventTarget
methods.description: Checks if a target element contains an event target.

methods.name: pasteUpload
methods.description: Handles paste events to upload files from clipboard.

methods.name: keyUpload
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for triggering file upload.

methods.name: cancelUpload
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing upload by clientId.

methods.name: handleMaxUploadReached
methods.description: Handles case when maximum upload limit is reached.

methods.name: handleLocalFileUploaded
methods.description: Handles local file selection, triggers upload or limit message.

methods.name: simulateInputClick
methods.description: Simulates click on file input element.
